label: Hint items have no attack
summary: Items of category 2 (ASS's Hint items) are treated like food and medicine when attack is calculated, so they show and deal no weapon attack.

edits.why: GetEquipProperties: 'cat==6 || cat==10' (food/medicine keep their raw attack) -> '(cat^2)&3==0' (also category 2 = THROW_1)
CalcAttack: the same category test widened to category 2 (attack 0 for THROW_1 items)

vanilla.reason: In vanilla category 2 is the Heaven Sword, Shakram and Runesword, which would lose their attack; this only makes sense with ASS's Hint items.

notes: (cat^2)&3==0 matches categories 2, 6, 10, 14 = THROW_1, FOOD, MEDICINE. ASS 2.0 has 22 items in category 2 (food Hints 0x1E-0x2A/0x3F and the Hint items 0x94-0x9E) and none of the three vanilla THROW_1 weapons. Added between image t (09-27) and b (10-01), no PPF. Probably part of the food/Hint work; could be merged into instant-food (ASS only).
